title: Lift a restricted coefficient unit to its single complex
statement: If the raw restricted coefficient at an identity arrow is heterogeneously equal to upperStarId on the restricted sheaf, then restrictedAffineSingleTransition is the transported complex unit. The coefficient hypothesis is supplied separately by inverse-image restriction coherence.

proof.text: Prove the generic single-complex unit equation by to_single_hom_ext. Rewrite its degree-zero component using singleMapHomologicalComplex_hom_app_self and single_map_f_self, cancel the evaluation isomorphism, and apply naturality of the unit. Substitute q = identity to turn the coefficient HEq into this generic equation. Separately eliminate the functor equality in the transported complex unit, and compose the two heterogeneous equalities. Instantiate with the restricted diagram map_id and the given raw coefficient unit. The generic private proof follows RestrictedOverSingleUnit.single_unit, without importing that module or its fixed-coefficient dependencies.

from.place: Lift the restricted sheaf coefficient unit

lean.statement:
theorem restrictedAffineSingleUnit_lift {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (U : S.Etale) (i : Iᵒᵖ)
    (hunit : HEq
      (rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient (D.map (𝟙 i)).left (D.obj i).hom (D.obj i).hom
        (Over.w (D.map (𝟙 i))) (F i.unop) (F i.unop) (φ (𝟙 i).unop) U)
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback U.hom (D.obj i).hom)).hom.app
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback.snd U.hom (D.obj i).hom)).obj
          (F i.unop)))) :
    restrictedAffineSingleTransition D F φ U (𝟙 i) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
          ((restrictedAffineDiagram D U).map_id i)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (restrictedAffineK D F U i) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((restrictedAffineDiagram D U).obj i))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (restrictedAffineK D F U i)
